attributes.projectDescription:
Created for the 2023 NWR Annual Meeting on the theme Fire, Flood and Drought: Climate Adaptation in the Nechako Watershed.

A portal submission with more details, documents, data and other resources can be accessed here.

Figures and animations gathered on the theme of the meeting that may be of interest. Maps and layers of interest can be found on 

Wildfires in 2023 (map created using the Fire Perimeters - Current dataset from the BC Data Catalogue).

Corrected PurpleAir (PA) Monitor data at UNBC from May - October 2023 (figure downloaded from AQmap).

Drought levels in 2022 (map created using the BC Drought Level Archive 2022 from the BC Data Catalogue).

Corrected PurpleAir (PA) Monitor data at UNBC, Vanderhoof, Burns Lake, and Takla Lake from May - October 2023 (map created using data from AQmap). 

Fire, flood, and landslide evacuation alerts in 2023 (map created using the Historical Orders and Alerts dataset from the BC Data Catalogue).

Total number of Smoky Skies Bulletins issued
